why: Totentanz is Maelstrom's club in Northside, Watson: a street-level lift, a guarded entrance, a bar, a lounge and a dancefloor. Vanilla only fills it through the sq011 side job and the Northside ambient phase, so it stands empty when those do not run. This proposal restores the intact interior, the pre-quest party crowd, the Maelstrom door crew and guard detail, the lift and entrance doors, and the normal club crowd/music variants.

open_questions: DJ: the only DJ workspot in the venue (base\workspots\bar\ground\generic__stand_ground__dj__01.workspot at -1715.24, 2190.70, 88.23) belongs to #sq011_ws_tinitus_ma, with tinitus_mb/wa on cheer spots beside it. Those entries are in the quest crowd (#com_quest_totentanz, phase crowd), not the pre-quest crowd. Evidence: sectors quest_f273cd123be13fca.streamingsector refs under #loc_quest_totentanz/#sq011_ws_tinitus_*; embedded ws_loc_totentanz_quest activates them in the quest-crowd block. Confirm on the tour that tinitus_* is the club's regular DJ trio (and neutral) and not a quest-only scene; if it is scene-only, the venue needs another DJ source.

Bar staff: no bartender/barman community or workspot exists for this venue. The bar spots are patron-side only (generic__stand_bar_whisky__drink__01, sit_barstool, stand_bar_lean_*). Evidence: sectors spot list for #loc_pre_quest_totentanz; communities.json has no bartender entry for #com_pre_quest_totentanz/#com_quest_totentanz. The bar cannot be staffed from vanilla quest data — confirm whether a baked base-world vendor stands behind the bar, or accept an unattended bar.

Dancefloor and music facts: the dancefloor is run by the kept dancefloors.questphase — prefab #dancefloor_totentanz, scene base\open_world\scenes\dancefloors\dancefloor_totentanz.scene, trigger #dancefloor_tr_totentanz, fact totentanz_dancefloor_on. The scene starts only when the player is inside the trigger and no other NPC is in it. Evidence: dancefloors.questphase.json (phase id 50, pause on totentanz_dancefloor_on). Verify the dance floor animates in clean-slate; the crowd_party variant only covers ambience, not the scene.

Lift floor state: sq011_nancy hides floor 1 (HideFloor 1) and sq011_quest_bugfixes shows floors 0,1,2 (ShowFloor). This proposal only re-enables the lift and does not touch floors, assuming the prefab default shows all floors. If the tour finds a missing floor button, add ShowFloor 0/1/2.

Maelstrom neutrality: the venue has a security area node sq011_totentanz_security_area_dangerous and a security system sq011_totentanz_security_system (sectors exterior_-27_34_1_0.streamingsector device nodes). The mod's existing SAFE override should cover this; confirm the 14 #sq011_club_gangers guards and the door crew do not turn hostile. The guard spots also sit in sq011_totentanz_combat_prefabBKT425Q, so confirm that sub-prefab streams under #sq011_pr_totentanz in the default interior variant.

Prefab ownership/duplication: clean_slate_spec.json does not list wat_nid_phase or its embedded ws_loc_totentanz_quest.questphase among kept phases, so #loc_pre_quest_totentanz, #loc_quest_totentanz and #sq011_pr_totentanz are free. If the district community phase is later kept, it would declare #loc_pre_quest_totentanz/#loc_quest_totentanz again and the venue phase must drop them (rule 2). The embedded phase also reactivates pre_quest_IC_005_b; our Activate is idempotent.

Bouncer count: #totentanz_bouncer has a `default` phase and a `sq011_bouncer_elevator` phase with two distinct spots (elevator + side). Vanilla uses `default` in the open world and the quest uses sq011_bouncer_elevator. Only `default` is proposed; check on the tour whether a second bouncer at the side spot is wanted.

Variant `#loc_sq011_totentanz_audio` crowd_party semantics: it is toggled with the crowd (1 when the party crowd is in, 0 at cleanup), but it is not documented; confirm it is the club ambience/party layer and not a quest-only mix.

proximity_wait.why: A device entity (not a workspot) sitting where every visitor arrives: the street-level lift that is the club's only way up. Vanilla drives the same lift from its ambient phase, so the anchor is streamed with the venue. It also matches the device leaf this proposal re-enables.
